L16: is a self-contained unit of a discourse in writing dealing with a particular 
L17: point or idea. A paragraph consists of one or more sentences. Though not 
L18: required by the syntax of any language, paragraphs are usually an expected part 
L19: of formal writing, used to organize longer prose.
